translations.web: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.
translations.bsb: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.
translations.kjv: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
translations.asv: Let them be put to shame and brought to dishonor that seek after my soul: Let them be turned back and confounded that devise my hurt.
